title: 关闭的牛肉工厂：大多不会重开，社区经济冲击有多大？
speaker: Alina Peng

segments.en: yeah that's the really difficult thing the US cattle herd is super cyclical so like a decade ago when we went through a similar cycle we also saw meat packing plants close it's largely the case that unfortunately they don't come back
segments.zh: 这确实是个难题。美国牛群具有强周期性，十年前类似周期中，我们也看到肉类加工厂关闭，不幸的是，它们大多不会重新开放。

segments.en: which tends to have a very large community economic impact the meat packers tend to offset that by making their existing plants more efficient but the USDA also very conscientious of this has an ounce like a five hundred million dollar investment into mid sized beef profits processors specifically
segments.zh: 这往往对社区经济产生巨大影响。肉类加工商倾向于通过提高现有工厂效率来抵消影响。美国农业部也意识到这一点，投入5亿美元支持中型牛肉加工商。

segments.en: so that they might be able to weather these high cattle costs for a little longer instead of folding
segments.zh: 这样他们就能在牛价高企的情况下多撑一段时间，而不是倒闭。
